title: 第13章 感情升温第14章 二级凶兽吞天蟒
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: “郑公子，谢谢你，你嘴没事吧？”
楚琳的腿被郑元细心包扎好后一脸关心的问道。
当然一张俏脸更是羞得通红一片，那就是包扎伤口时两个人避免不了肌肤再次接触。
“没事，这是余毒，我运功驱除一下就好了。”
郑元运转起了真气，心里暗暗高兴不已。
其实当时还有方法替楚琳驱除毒血，那就是用金针刺穴。
下一刻郑元突然暗暗一惊，那就感觉体内的过剩阳气好像要沸腾了。
不会吧，就是吸了几口蛇毒，居然要被引发体内阳气震动。
郑元赶紧催动真气强行压制着，一时间头上不禁冒汗了。
“郑公子，要不你也在帐篷里休息吧，反正也够大，还能防止再有野兽入侵……”
楚琳此时也看出了郑元脸上情形不太好，难道是那毒血的原因。
心里更是感动不已，当然一颗芳心也在慢慢变化中。
郑元自然是一口答应了，虽然还不能立刻推倒，不过却是加深感情的好时机。
其实就是没有造化纯阴之体，城主女儿楚琳温柔善良，而且貌美如花，面冷心热，为了娘亲独自上山采药，郑元也早就动心了。
啊！
天亮时分，楚琳嘴里发出一声惊呼。
自己的胳膊不知道怎么就搭在了郑公子的身上。
这也太羞人了，楚琳看到郑元还没醒，赶紧轻轻地把手拿了下来。
心里更是砰砰加速跳了起来，昨晚郑公子恪守礼法，也没有做出出格的事情，果然是正人君子。
楚琳此时对郑元的好感度又上升了一分。
“咦，楚小姐你醒了，咱们收拾一下，再去找百年黄莲精。”
郑元其实早就醒了，楚小姐的玉手光滑如玉，那会自然是舍不得醒了。
楚琳嘴里轻轻答应了一句，俏脸上的红晕还没有下去呢。
就在下一刻两人突然呆住了，那就是帐篷并不大，两人又同时站了起来。
结果两人撞在了一起，啪，郑元忍不住吸了一下。
楚琳更是惊呆住了，感觉浑身上下犹如一道电流划过。
“楚小姐，我真不是故意要亵渎你，刚才实在是……”
郑元呆过后也不禁尴尬的不行，关键是哪个男人能顶得住眼前的绝色美女。
楚琳更是不知所措的捏着衣服角，不过俏脸上并没有怒意，反而是安慰着郑元。
content_en:
"Mr. Zheng, thank you. Is your mouth okay?"
Chu Lin asked with concern after her leg was carefully bandaged by Zheng Yuan.
Of course, her pretty face turned red with embarrassment, because when bandaging the wound, the two of them could not avoid skin contact again.
"It's okay. This is residual poison. I can just use my energy to get rid of it."
Zheng Yuan circulated his true energy and was secretly happy.
In fact, there was still a way to get rid of Chu Lin's poisonous blood at that time, and that was to use gold needles to prick acupuncture points.
The next moment, Zheng Yuan was suddenly startled, feeling that the excess yang energy in his body was about to boil.
No way, just taking a few mouthfuls of snake venom will actually trigger a vibration of Yang Qi in the body.
Zheng Yuan quickly activated his energy to suppress it, and for a while he couldn't help but sweating on his head.
"Mr. Zheng, why don't you also rest in the tent? It's big enough anyway and can prevent further wild beasts from invading..."
At this time, Chu Lin also saw that Zheng Yuan's face was not in a good condition. Could it be because of the poisonous blood?
I was even more moved in my heart, and of course my heart was slowly changing.
Zheng Yuan naturally agreed. Although he couldn't reject it immediately, it was a good time to deepen the relationship.
In fact, there was no pure yin body created. The city lord's daughter Chu Lin was gentle and kind, and she was as beautiful as a flower, with a cold face and a warm heart. Zheng Yuan had already been tempted by going up the mountain alone to collect medicine for her mother.
……
ah!
At dawn, Chu Lin let out an exclamation.
I don't know why my arm was on Mr. Zheng's body.
This was too embarrassing. Seeing that Zheng Yuan was still awake, Chu Lin quickly took her hand down gently.
My heart was beating faster and faster. Mr. Zheng abided by the etiquette last night and did not do anything extraordinary. He was indeed a gentleman.
Chu Lin's favorability towards Zheng Yuan increased by one point at this time.
"Hey, Miss Chu, wake up. Let's clean up and go find the century-old yellow lotus essence."
Zheng Yuan had actually woken up a long time ago. Miss Chu's jade hands were as smooth as jade, so he was naturally reluctant to wake up.
"Yeah!"
Chu Lin promised softly, the blush on her pretty face not going away yet.
At the next moment, the two of them suddenly froze, that is, the tent was not big, and they stood up at the same time.
As a result, the two of them bumped into each other, and Zheng Yuan couldn't help but suck.
Chu Lin was even more shocked, feeling like an electric current passing through her whole body.
"Miss Chu, I really didn't mean to blaspheme you. Just now..."
Zheng Yuan couldn't help but feel embarrassed after being there. The key was which man could stand up to the stunning beauty in front of him.
Chu Lin was even more confused and pinched the corner of her clothes, but there was no anger on her pretty face, but she comforted Zheng Yuan.
